title: Jean Gabin, sors de là!  (Jean Gabin, Get Out of There!)

segments.t: Outside Mathias's office, the assistants are buzzing with curiosity. A mysterious luxury bag has arrived, and Noémie is convinced it contains a massive cash loan from Catherine's wealthy father to finance Mathias's takeover of the agency. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Il ne paierait pas en liquide!
Si! Le beau-père a des biens immobiliers à Paris.
Quand les acheteurs achètent, ils paient en liquide. C'est bien connu.
Donc c'est du liquide.
C'est comme ça que Mathias va devenir notre patron.
Et moi je deviendrai son bras droit.
Alors il te demandera en mariage.
Tu crois? Non! Je vais jeter un coup d'œil.
Non, Noémie! Tu es folle? Fais attention!
Mathias sait que tout ce que je fais, c'est pour son bien.
Donc il récompensera ma loyauté. Fais le guet, d'accord?
Jean Gabin! Quoi? Jean Gabin est en train d'abîmer l'argent!
Rends-le, Jean Gabin! Ce n'est pas vrai!
Noémie, sors de là!
Let's examine how Noémie's curiosity leads to immediate chaos.
Il ne paierait pas en liquide!
'He would not pay in cash!' Hervé expresses disbelief that an agency buyout would arrive in bank notes.
Si! Le beau-père a des biens immobiliers à Paris.
'Yes he would! The father-in-law owns real estate in Paris.' Noémie explains that Catherine's father has massive property holdings.
Quand les acheteurs achètent, ils paient en liquide. C'est bien connu.
'When buyers purchase property, they pay in cash. That is well known.' She points out that luxury deals often involve cash.
Donc c'est du liquide.
'So it is cash.' Hervé concedes that the bag might actually be filled with currency.
C'est comme ça que Mathias va devenir notre patron.
'That is how Mathias is going to become our boss.' Noémie dreams about Mathias taking over the agency.
Et moi je deviendrai son bras droit.
'And I will become his right-hand woman.' She imagines herself as his indispensable deputy.
Alors il te demandera en mariage.
'Then he will ask you to marry him.' Hervé teases her gently about her feelings for Mathias.
Tu crois? Non! Je vais jeter un coup d'œil.
'You think so? No! I am going to take a look.' Flustered by the remark, she resolves to peek inside the bag.
Non, Noémie! Tu es folle? Fais attention!
'No, Noémie! Are you crazy? Be careful!' Hervé warns her that sneaking into the office is reckless.
Mathias sait que tout ce que je fais, c'est pour son bien.
'Mathias knows that everything I do is for his own good.' She rationalizes her snooping as pure devotion.
Donc il récompensera ma loyauté. Fais le guet, d'accord?
'So he will reward my loyalty. Keep watch, okay?' Noémie orders Hervé to guard the corridor.
Jean Gabin! Quoi? Jean Gabin est en train d'abîmer l'argent!
'Jean Gabin! What? Jean Gabin is ruining the money!' Hervé gasps as the dog damages the cash on the floor.
Rends-le, Jean Gabin! Ce n'est pas vrai!
'Give it back, Jean Gabin! I cannot believe it!' Noémie desperately tries to rescue the bills from the puppy.
Noémie, sors de là!
'Noémie, get out of there!' Hervé urgently tells her to escape before anyone discovers the catastrophe. Now let's listen to the scene between Noémie and Hervé once more.

Si! Le beau-père a des biens immobiliers à Paris.
Quand les acheteurs achètent, ils paient en liquide. C'est bien connu.

Noémie, sors de là!

Noémie's secret inspection has ended in total catastrophe thanks to Jean Gabin the dog. Meanwhile, Andréa is meeting director Christophe Bel at a restaurant, striking a delicate deal to keep the plastic duck in the production while sparing François from entering the pool. See you next time!
Bonne soirée!
